title: Proposal for Prohibition against Attendance Bonus which is a Disincentive for Employees Taking Medical Leave
what_it_is: Proposal for Prohibition against Attendance Bonus which is a Disincentive for Employees Taking Medical Leave

sections.label: Sick leave incentive schemes
sections.summary: Attendance incentive schemes using sick leave are contrary to the principle, and TAFEP will engage employers, with enforcement action possible.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Attendance-related incentive schemes that consider sick leave utilisation are contrary to this principle.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Companies should therefore review and make adjustments where necessary.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: From next year onwards, the Tripartite Alliance for Fair and Progressive Employment Practices (TAFEP) will engage and advise employers who still continue with such schemes to stop doing so.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: If they continue with the practice, TAFEP will recommend to MOM to take enforcement action, which could include the suspension of work pass privileges.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Tripartite Committee on Workplace Fairness is deliberating on the scope and design of legislation to enshrine the TGFEP in law.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The key objective of this new legislation is to provide a strong statement against workplace discrimination and broaden the range of actions that can be taken when workplace discrimination on the basis of characteristics such as age, nationality or race occurs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Together with tripartite partners, we adopt a range of approaches, such as guidelines and education, that are effective in addressing various workplace issues.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: It is not necessary to rely on legislation as a solution to every workplace issue.

sections.label: Legislating workplace discrimination rules
sections.summary: TAFEP will engage employers to stop the practice, or suspension of work pass privileges will be taken as enforcement action.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: I think we can do that through legislating this into the upcoming legislation on workplace discrimination.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, TAFEP will engage employers and recommend that they stop doing so or we will take suspension of work pass privileges as an enforcement action on employers who continue to do this practice.
